Basics & feedback

Accordion

A stack of headings that each expand to reveal a section of content.

ReadyWhen to use: FAQs, settings groups: when users only need one or two sections at a time.
Status: Ready, Works and is tested in this page.
Code name data-ui="accordion" · shadcn: Accordion · Metronic: Accordion

single

ქართული საზოგადოებრივი პორტალი.

Headless UI primitives.

-

multiple

Open by default
Also open

<div data-ui="accordion" data-type="single" data-default-value="a">
  <div data-ui-part="item" data-value="a">
    <h3>
      <button data-ui-part="trigger">რა არის Despani?</button>
    </h3>

import { Accordion, Part } from "@colibri-kit/ui/react";

export function Demo() {
  return (
    <>
      <h4>single</h4>
      <Accordion data-type="single" data-default-value="a">
        <Part name="item" value="a">
          <h3>
            <Part name="trigger" as="button">რა არის Despani?</Part>
          </h3>
          <Part name="content">ქართული საზოგადოებრივი პორტალი.</Part>
        </Part>
        <Part name="item" value="b">
          <h3>
            <Part name="trigger" as="button">Colibri UI?</Part>
          </h3>
          <Part name="content">Headless UI primitives.</Part>
        </Part>
        <Part name="item" value="c" data-disabled>
          <h3>
            <Part name="trigger" as="button">Disabled item</Part>
          </h3>
          <Part name="content">-</Part>
        </Part>
      </Accordion>
      <h4>multiple</h4>
      <Accordion data-type="multiple" data-default-value="x,y">
        <Part name="item" value="x">
          <Part name="trigger" as="button">X</Part>
          <Part name="content">Open by default</Part>
        </Part>
        <Part name="item" value="y">
          <Part name="trigger" as="button">Y</Part>
          <Part name="content">Also open</Part>
        </Part>
      </Accordion>
    </>
  );
}
Accessibility & keyboard

Trigger = button[aria-expanded][aria-controls]; content role=region. Up/Down/Home/End move between triggers. data-type=single|multiple, data-collapsible.

Alert banner

A message box that tells the user something important, with an optional close button.

ReadyWhen to use: Success / error / info messages inside the page (not popups).
Status: Ready, Works and is tested in this page.

</div>

import { Part, UI } from "@colibri-kit/ui/react";

export function Demo() {
  return (
    <>
      <UI kind="dismiss" role="status">
        <span>
          <strong>ინფორმაცია:</strong>
          ცვლილებები შენახულია.
        </span>
        <Part name="close" as="button" aria-label="Close">×</Part>
      </UI>
      <UI kind="dismiss" role="alert" data-variant="destructive" data-remove="false">
        <span>
          <strong>შეცდომა:</strong>
          ვერ მოხერხდა.
        </span>
        <Part name="close" as="button" aria-label="Close">×</Part>
      </UI>
    </>
  );
}
Accessibility & keyboard

role=alert or role=status. Close removes node; cancel ui:beforedismiss to veto; data-remove=false hides instead.

Native button. api.loading=true sets disabled + aria-busy + data-state=loading. data-variant / data-size are styling only.

import { ButtonGroup } from "@colibri-kit/ui/react";

export function Demo() {
  return (
    <div className="bg-demo">
      <div>
        <small className="muted">Actions (click flashes; not a toggle)</small>
        <ButtonGroup data-label="File actions" id="bg-actions">
          <button>Copy</button>
          <button>Paste</button>
          <button>Delete</button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      </div>
      <div>
        <small className="muted">Pick one (required)</small>
        <ButtonGroup
          data-label="Text align"
          data-type="single"
          data-required
          data-value="center"
          data-name="align"
          id="bg-align"
        >
          <button data-value="left">Left</button>
          <button data-value="center">Center</button>
          <button data-value="right">Right</button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      </div>
      <div>
        <small className="muted">Pick several</small>
        <ButtonGroup data-label="Text style" data-type="multiple" data-value="bold" id="bg-style">
          <button data-value="bold" aria-label="Bold">
            <b>B</b>
          </button>
          <button data-value="italic" aria-label="Italic">
            <i>I</i>
          </button>
          <button data-value="underline" aria-label="Underline">
            <u>U</u>
          </button>
          <button data-value="strike" disabled aria-label="Strikethrough (unavailable)">
            <s>S</s>
          </button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      </div>
      <div>
        <small className="muted">Vertical</small>
        <ButtonGroup data-label="View" data-type="single" data-orientation="vertical" data-value="list" id="bg-view">
          <button data-value="list">List</button>
          <button data-value="grid">Grid</button>
          <button data-value="board">Board</button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      </div>
      <p className="bg-out" id="bg-out" aria-live="polite">Align: center · Style: bold · View: list</p>
    </div>
  );
}
Accessibility & keyboard

role=group with aria-label. One Tab stop: Left/Right (Up/Down when vertical), Home and End move between buttons. With data-type=single|multiple the buttons are toggles with aria-pressed and the group emits ui:change {value}; data-required keeps one pressed; data-name submits the value with a form.

Technical names: data-ui="button-group" · shadcn “Button Group” · Metronic “Button Group”

            <p>Ask anything. Minimize me with − and I hang on the line above.</p>
          </Part>
          <Part name="resize" as="span" aria-hidden="true" />
        </UI>
        <UI
          kind="cell"
          as="section"
          id="cl-projects"
          data-line="#cl-line"
          data-name="Projects"
          data-mark="◈"
          style={{ left: "250px", top: "96px" }}
        >
          <Part name="header" as="header">
            <Part name="mark" as="span" aria-hidden="true">◈</Part>
            <Part name="title" as="span">Projects</Part>
            <Part name="minimize" as="button" title="Hang on clothline">−</Part>
            <Part name="maximize" as="button" aria-pressed="false">□</Part>
            <Part name="close" as="button">×</Part>
          </Part>
          <Part name="body">
            <p>Drag my header to move, the corner grip to resize, □ to maximize.</p>
          </Part>
          <Part name="resize" as="span" aria-hidden="true" />
        </UI>
        <UI
          kind="cell"
          as="section"
          id="cl-menu"
          data-line="#cl-line"
          data-name="Menu"
          data-mark="≡"
          style={{ left: "470px", top: "60px" }}
        >
          <Part name="header" as="header">
            <Part name="mark" as="span" aria-hidden="true">≡</Part>
            <Part name="title" as="span">Menu</Part>
            <Part name="minimize" as="button" title="Hang on clothline">−</Part>
            <Part name="maximize" as="button" aria-pressed="false">□</Part>
            <Part name="close" as="button">×</Part>
          </Part>
          <Part name="body">
            <p>Minimize all three, then restore from the line. × on a tag closes for good.</p>
          </Part>
          <Part name="resize" as="span" aria-hidden="true" />
        </UI>
      </div>
      <p style={{ flexBasis: "100%", textAlign: "center" }}>
        <UI kind="button" as="button" data-variant="outline" id="cl-reset">Reset desk</UI>
      </p>
    </>
  );
}
Accessibility & keyboard

Cells are regions labelled by their title; minimize/maximize/close buttons get 'Minimize Answers' style labels. Minimizing moves focus to the new tag on the line; restoring moves focus back into the cell. The line is a navigation landmark ('Minimized cells'); ←/→/Home/End move between tags. Alt+Arrows on a focused header moves the cell, Alt+Shift+Arrows resizes it; Esc leaves maximize.

          </Part>
        </Part>

        <Part name="choices">

            <b>Web</b>
            <span />
          </Part>
          <Part name="choice" as="button" value="ios">
            <b>iOS</b>
            <span />
          </Part>
          <Part name="choice" as="button" value="android">
            <b>Android</b>
            <span />
          </Part>
        </Part>
        <Part name="error" as="p" />
      </Part>
      <Part name="item" as="fieldset" data-name="notes" data-type="text" data-skippable>
        <Part name="title" as="legend">Anything else?</Part>
        <Part name="description" as="p">Optional.</Part>
        <Part name="input" as="textarea" rows="2" aria-label="Notes" />
        <Part name="error" as="p" />
      </Part>
      <Part name="actions">
        <Part name="previous" as="button" data-ui="button" data-variant="ghost">Back</Part>
        <span style={{ flex: "1" }} />
        <Part name="skip" as="button" data-ui="button" data-variant="outline">Skip</Part>
        <Part name="next" as="button" data-ui="button">Next</Part>
        <Part name="submit" as="button" type="submit" data-ui="button">Submit</Part>
      </Part>
      <Part name="summary" tabIndex="-1" hidden>
        <b>Thanks!</b>
        <span id="qn-out" className="muted" />
      </Part>
    </UI>
  );
}

    Accessibility & keyboard

    Composed from Sidebar (data-state expanded/collapsed, toggles get aria-expanded/aria-controls; Ctrl/Cmd+B in apps, off here so blocks don't fight), Collapsible, Dropdown menu, Popover, Tooltip, Calendar and File tree. Below the breakpoint the sidebar becomes an off-canvas sheet (Esc / outside click closes). The current page link has aria-current=page.

    Technical names: data-ui="sidebar-04" · shadcn “Block sidebar-04” · Metronic “Sidebar layouts”

    Accessibility & keyboard

    Composed from Sidebar (data-state expanded/collapsed, toggles get aria-expanded/aria-controls; Ctrl/Cmd+B in apps, off here so blocks don't fight), Collapsible, Dropdown menu, Popover, Tooltip, Calendar and File tree. Below the breakpoint the sidebar becomes an off-canvas sheet (Esc / outside click closes). The current page link has aria-current=page.

    Technical names: data-ui="sidebar-06" · shadcn “Block sidebar-06” · Metronic “Sidebar layouts”

    Sidebar · Collapses to icons

    Collapses to a narrow icon rail (Ctrl/Cmd+B on the real app); hover icons for tooltips.

    ReadyWhen to use: App shells, docs sites and dashboards. Copy the markup and swap in your links.
    Status: Ready, Works and is tested in this page.

    Accessibility & keyboard

    Composed from Sidebar (data-state expanded/collapsed, toggles get aria-expanded/aria-controls; Ctrl/Cmd+B in apps, off here so blocks don't fight), Collapsible, Dropdown menu, Popover, Tooltip, Calendar and File tree. Below the breakpoint the sidebar becomes an off-canvas sheet (Esc / outside click closes). The current page link has aria-current=page.

    Technical names: data-ui="sidebar-07" · shadcn “Block sidebar-07” · Metronic “Sidebar layouts”

    Sidebar · Inset with secondary nav

    The content sits in an inset card; extra links are pinned at the bottom.

    ReadyWhen to use: App shells, docs sites and dashboards. Copy the markup and swap in your links.
    Status: Ready, Works and is tested in this page.

    Accessibility & keyboard

    Accessibility & keyboard

    Composed from Sidebar (data-state expanded/collapsed, toggles get aria-expanded/aria-controls; Ctrl/Cmd+B in apps, off here so blocks don't fight), Collapsible, Dropdown menu, Popover, Tooltip, Calendar and File tree. Below the breakpoint the sidebar becomes an off-canvas sheet (Esc / outside click closes). The current page link has aria-current=page.

    Technical names: data-ui="sidebar-15" · shadcn “Block sidebar-15” · Metronic “Sidebar layouts”

    Sidebar · Sticky site header

    A full-width sticky header above the sidebar and content.

    ReadyWhen to use: App shells, docs sites and dashboards. Copy the markup and swap in your links.

    Accessibility & keyboard

    Composed from Sidebar (data-state expanded/collapsed, toggles get aria-expanded/aria-controls; Ctrl/Cmd+B in apps, off here so blocks don't fight), Collapsible, Dropdown menu, Popover, Tooltip, Calendar and File tree. Below the breakpoint the sidebar becomes an off-canvas sheet (Esc / outside click closes). The current page link has aria-current=page.

    Technical names: data-ui="sidebar-16" · shadcn “Block sidebar-16” · Metronic “Sidebar layouts”

    Accessibility & keyboard

    One <form data-ui=auth-form novalidate> with several views (password, magic-link, forgot, sent, otp, done); only the visible view is validated/submitted and its first field gets focus. Errors use Field (aria-invalid + aria-describedby, role=alert); a polite status line reports the result. Provider buttons emit ui:provider; submit emits cancelable ui:submit {view, values}. Toggle-password, Checkbox, Pin input, Separator and Card are the same components as elsewhere.

    Accessibility & keyboard

    One <form data-ui=auth-form novalidate> with several views (password, magic-link, forgot, sent, otp, done); only the visible view is validated/submitted and its first field gets focus. Errors use Field (aria-invalid + aria-describedby, role=alert); a polite status line reports the result. Provider buttons emit ui:provider; submit emits cancelable ui:submit {view, values}. Toggle-password, Checkbox, Pin input, Separator and Card are the same components as elsewhere.

    Technical names: data-ui="login-02" · shadcn “Block login-02” · Metronic “Authentication pages”

    Login · Muted background

    One <form data-ui=auth-form novalidate> with several views (password, magic-link, forgot, sent, otp, done); only the visible view is validated/submitted and its first field gets focus. Toggle-password, Checkbox, Pin input, Separator and Card are the same components as elsewhere.

    One <form data-ui=auth-form novalidate> with several views (password, magic-link, forgot, sent, otp, done); only the visible view is validated/submitted and its first field gets focus. Errors use Field (aria-invalid + aria-describedby, role=alert); a polite status line reports the result. Provider buttons emit ui:provider; submit emits cancelable ui:submit {view, values}. Toggle-password, Checkbox, Pin input, Separator and Card are the same components as elsewhere.

    Accessibility & keyboard

    One <form data-ui=auth-form novalidate> with several views (password, magic-link, forgot, sent, otp, done); only the visible view is validated/submitted and its first field gets focus. Errors use Field (aria-invalid + aria-describedby, role=alert); a polite status line reports the result. Provider buttons emit ui:provider; submit emits cancelable ui:submit {view, values}. Toggle-password, Checkbox, Pin input, Separator and Card are the same components as elsewhere.

              </p>

            <Part name="view" data-view="otp" data-next="done">
              <h2 className="auth-h">Enter verification code</h2>
              <p className="muted">We sent a 6-digit code to your email.</p>
              <div
                data-ui="pin-input"
                data-length="6"
                data-name="otp"
                data-type="numeric"
                data-required
                aria-label="Verification code"
              />
              <button data-ui="button" type="submit" className="auth-full">Verify</button>
              <p className="muted auth-small">
                Didn't receive it?
                <button type="button" className="auth-link" data-ui-auth-view="signup">Go back</button>
              </p>
            </Part>
            <Part name="view" data-view="done">
              <h2 className="auth-h">You're in 🎉</h2>
              <p className="muted">This is where the app would redirect.</p>
              <button type="button" className="auth-link" data-ui-auth-view="signup">Start over</button>
            </Part>
            <Part name="status" as="p" />
          </UI>
        </article>
        <p className="auth-terms muted">
          By clicking continue, you agree to our
          <a href="#">Terms of Service</a>
          and
          <a href="#">Privacy Policy</a>
          .
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  );
}
    Accessibility & keyboard

    One <form data-ui=auth-form novalidate> with several views (password, magic-link, forgot, sent, otp, done); only the visible view is validated/submitted and its first field gets focus. Errors use Field (aria-invalid + aria-describedby, role=alert); a polite status line reports the result. Provider buttons emit ui:provider; submit emits cancelable ui:submit {view, values}. Toggle-password, Checkbox, Pin input, Separator and Card are the same components as elsewhere.

    Technical names: data-ui="signup-05" · shadcn “Block signup-05” · Metronic “Authentication pages”

    Accessibility & keyboard

    Enter plays whenever the element appears; exit plays a non-interactive ghost copy, so components keep their synchronous state and focus logic. Everything turns off with prefers-reduced-motion or the Animations switch.

    Technical names: data-ui="motion" · shadcn “(tw-animate / data-[state] animations)” · Metronic “-”

    Status: Ready, Works and is tested in this page.

    Hover and focus presets use CSS transitions; loops are infinite CSS animations that become static with reduced motion.

    ReadyWhen to use: Validation errors, success feedback, drawing attention to a change.

    Accessibility & keyboard

    Tokens cascade, so any container can re-theme just its own subtree. This box sets a teal primary, square corners, compact controls and a serif font, with the same components and markup.

    Technical names: data-ui="theme-scoped" · shadcn “-” · Metronic “-”

    Colibri CSS

    Getting started

    One stylesheet: reset, tokens, base styles, a few layout primitives and opt-in components, all in cascade layers.

    ReadyWhen to use: Plain sites, FreeMarker pages and anywhere you want good defaults without a utility framework.
    Status: Ready, Works and is tested in this page.
    Code name data-ui="css-start" · shadcn: - · Metronic: -
    Drag the corner to resize the preview

    Why Colibri CSS

    Modern CSS, not class soup. One 15 KB stylesheet with no build step: finished defaults for semantic HTML, OKLCH tokens driven by one --c-hue, fluid type, built-in dark mode, and a handful of layout primitives. It's the styling half of Colibri: Colibri UI handles behaviour, Colibri CSS handles the look.

    • Layers: your CSS always wins, no !important.
    • Tokens: re-brand globally or per section by changing one value.
    • Primitives, not utilities: .stack .grid .split .cluster… tuned with custom properties, responsive with no breakpoints.
    • Platform-native: container queries, :has(), nesting, light-dark(), clamp().
    • Bridge: Colibri UI components share the same tokens.

    Read the full pitch, comparison table and setup on the library page: examples/colibri-css.html · package packages/colibri-css · README packages/colibri-css/README.md

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
    Accessibility & keyboard

    Use the System / Light / Dark buttons above the preview. The inner panel is always dark via data-theme on the element.

    Motion

    Duration and easing tokens (including a linear() spring). With prefers-reduced-motion they collapse to 0, so every transition built on them turns off automatically.

    ReadyWhen to use: Consistent, accessible transitions and enter animations.
    Status: Ready, Works and is tested in this page.

  transition: translate var(--c-dur-slow) var(--c-ease-spring);
  &:hover { translate: 2rem 0; } }
